name: Wix
tagline: A drag-and-drop website builder with an AI site generator, templates and built-in business tools.
bestFor: Small businesses that want an all-in-one site with selling and booking tools
description: Wix is a hosted website builder that lets users create a site from a prompt or a template and edit it with a drag-and-drop editor. Paid plans add a custom domain, more storage, and on Core and above, payments, ecommerce and scheduling.
pros: Free plan with no time limit
Free domain voucher for one year on yearly and multi-year plans
AI site generation and over 2,000 templates
cons: Free plan shows Wix branding and uses a wixsite.com address
Light plan cannot accept payments or sell online
Month-to-month prices are not shown on the pricing page

research.domainAfterYear1: Renews at Wix's regular domain price for the extension (no figure on the pricing page or the help article; voucher must be claimed within 60 days and is only for a new domain).
research.notes: The pricing page localises to INR from this location (Light ₹250, Core ₹500, Business ₹900, Business Elite ₹1,800 per month, yearly). The USD figures are the page's own 'USD prices displayed for reference only' shown before localisation; the page says final price is shown at checkout and prices vary by location. Only yearly prices are shown; monthly and multi-year prices are not on the page, so monthly and twoYear are null. Wix offers a 14-day money-back guarantee rather than a trial. The free domain voucher does not apply on plan renewal or upgrade. Memberships = Wix Pricing Plans / members area apps (subscriptions listed under 'Art and content monetization').

research.domainAfterYear1: Free domain (annual plans only, cheapest pricing tier, register within one year) renews at Squarespace's standard rate plus taxes after the first year; no figure stated.
research.notes: Squarespace prices per billing country. From this location the page showed INR (Basic ₹630, Core ₹720, Advanced ₹1,100 per month annual; ₹810/₹1,080/₹1,530 monthly). Switching the page's currency selector to USD showed India-region USD prices (Basic $7 annual / $9 monthly, Core $8 / $12, Advanced $12 / $17), and the page's structured data repeats these labelled as region 'US', but they match the India amounts converted and are far below US figures reported elsewhere, so they were not used. Third-party sites (checked Oct 2026, not verified) report US prices of Basic $19, Core $29, Advanced $99 per month annual and $25 / $39 / $139 monthly, and some list a Plus plan at $49 annual / $65 monthly that the page shown here did not include. Annual billing saves 'up to 36%'. The 50% off badge on each plan is the NOV50WF code, so the first annual payment for a new customer would be half the list price, renewing at full list price. Needs a US-located check.

name: WordPress.com
tagline: Managed WordPress hosting with a site builder, plugins and themes, run by Automattic.
bestFor: Bloggers and businesses that want WordPress without managing hosting
description: WordPress.com is Automattic's hosted version of WordPress, with a free plan and four paid plans that add a custom domain, plugins, storage and ecommerce. Plans can be paid monthly, yearly, or every two or three years, with lower monthly rates on longer terms.
pros: Plugin installation on every paid plan
Lower per-month rates on 2- and 3-year terms
cons: Free plan shows ads and uses a wordpress.com subdomain
Monthly plans do not include the free domain
WooCommerce store extensions only bundled on the Commerce plan

plans.name: Personal

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 13 GB storage, payment buttons (PayPal, Stripe), premium stats, video upload. 2-year $6.50/mo, 3-year $5.50/mo ($198 total).

plans.name: Business

research.domainAfterYear1: Renews at the standard domain price for the extension, separate from the plan (no figure stated). Free domain only on annual and multi-year plans.
research.notes: USD prices read from the pricing page's server-rendered price tiles (monthly, yearly, 2-yearly) and matched against WordPress.com's public plans API in USD (yearly totals $48/$96/$300/$540). After loading, the page localised to INR and showed a struck-through intro price on yearly Personal (₹200 to ₹160) in the FAQ, so a first-term discount may exist in some regions; none appears in USD. Monthly plans do not include a free domain. Memberships = paid content/subscriptions blocks; MemberPress plugin is also installable on paid plans.
